summary: Iteration 40 — 9434-3977 QC inc. Frontend validation of new AR features: Clients book, Credit notes (linked + standalone), Invoice reverse, Invoice edit (unpaid only), and paid_amount rule enforcement. 10/10 UI flows PASS. Playwright script (admin @1920x1080) logged in as admin@accslegro.com, navigated to QC entity (2026 open, unlocked). (1) qc-tab-clients renders qc-clients-view + qc-clients-table with existing clients. (2) qc-add-client → qc-client-dialog: created TEST_ClientUI_1786380412 with AR account 100105 chosen via qc-client-ar select (7 options loaded from asset accounts), saved via qc-client-save; new row appears in qc-clients-table. (3) qc-client-edit-<id> reopens dialog, added 'Attention Person' via qc-client-att, saved. (4) qc-tab-ar → qc-add-invoice → qc-invoice-dialog: qc-invoice-client-select populated with active clients from carnet; selecting our client pre-filled qc-invoice-client (name), applied AR account silently. Set line amount 500 → qc-invoice-totals rendered 'Total des ventes 500,00 · TPS 25,00 · TVQ 49,88 · TOTAL 574,88' — correct QC tax math. Saved via qc-invoice-save. (5) qc-invoice-edit-<id> visible for unpaid invoice, button label switched to 'Enregistrer les modifications', changed amount to 600 → totals recomputed to 689,85 correctly. (6) qc-invoice-credit-<id> → qc-credit-note-dialog (linked mode): client name locked, added CN line 100 → qc-cn-totals 114,98. Saved via qc-cn-save. NC-2026-003 appeared in qc-invoices-table with linked-invoice arrow '↩ 2026-005' and qc-status-applied badge (NC appliquée). Balance of linked invoice reduced correctly. (7) qc-add-credit-note (standalone) → qc-credit-note-dialog with qc-cn-client-select visible; picked TEST_ClientUI, added line 50, saved → NC-2026-004 appears with client TEST_ClientUI, balance (57,49) negative, qc-status-credit badge 'Note de crédit'. (8) Created a fresh 300$ invoice, clicked qc-invoice-reverse-<id> → qc-reverse-dialog → qc-reverse-confirm: invoice row now shows qc-status-reversed 'Extournée' with line-through styling, solde 0,00. Verified qc-invoice-edit-<id> and qc-invoice-reverse-<id> DISAPPEARED for reversed invoice. (9) RULE CHECK: created 777$ invoice, verified edit+reverse buttons present, then clicked qc-invoice-receive-<id> with $100 partial payment. AFTER partial payment: qc-invoice-edit-<id>=absent, qc-invoice-reverse-<id>=absent, qc-invoice-credit-<id>=PRESENT — matches spec exactly (canEditInvoice / canReverseInvoice gate on paid_amount==0, canCreditInvoice stays true). Invoice shows Partielle status with solde 793,36. (10) Non-regression: qc-tab-entries, qc-tab-tb (Balance de vérification), qc-tab-bilan (Bilan), qc-tab-pnl (États des résultats) all navigate and render without error (États des résultats screenshot shows Bénéfice net 1 919,99 $ with correct sections REVENUS/CHARGES/BAIIA/IMPÔTS). Final qc-invoices-table screenshot shows 12 factures with all 6 status badges (Ouverte, NC appliquée, Note de crédit, Extournée, Partielle) rendered with correct colors and data-testids.

issues: React hydration console warning persists: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' emitted by LineItemsEditor account <select> and qc-client-ar/qc-cn-client-select/qc-invoice-client-select. Same warning was already reported in iteration 39. Cosmetic only — does not affect selection behaviour but pollutes DevTools. Fix by rendering option label as plain template string instead of JSX expression: `{`${a.gl} · ${a.description}`}` -> `{a.gl + ' · ' + a.description}`.
Native browser date pickers still used for Date/Échéance (already flagged in iteration 39). Not a blocker.
Encaisser uses window.prompt() for amount entry — inconsistent with the rest of the app (shadcn dialogs). Not blocking but should be modernised for consistency and validation.

action_items: Optional: silence the <span> in <option> hydration warning by concatenating strings inside <option>.
Optional: replace window.prompt in receive() with a shadcn dialog with amount input + max=balance validation.
critical_code_review_comments: QcEntity.js is now 1717 lines — should be split into /app/frontend/src/pages/qc9434/ subfolder (Clients, Invoices, CreditNote, Bills, Opening, TrialBalance, Bilan, PnL) to stay maintainable.

canEditInvoice/canReverseInvoice/canCreditInvoice helpers correctly gate on r.paid_amount and r.credited_amount — good defensive UI but the same rules must exist server-side (backend already tested in iteration 39, confirmed).

InvoicesView.receive uses window.prompt('') which returns a string; empty string is Number('')=0 which then triggers 'full balance' interpretation via API — behaviour is documented but subtle. Consider explicit UI 'Solde complet' toggle.

CreditNoteDialog.save button disable condition uses `linked && total > remaining + 0.005` — good, respects tolerance; but 'remaining' comes from the invoice's balance at dialog open time; if another user reduces the balance elsewhere it could still exceed on the server. Backend should also enforce this (already tested in iter 39).
The credit-note badges are correctly styled (violet), Extournée row has line-through and text-slate-400 dim — accessible contrast is preserved.
